people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.
translations.bsb: If a man is found lying with another man’s wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.
translations.kjv: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband, then they shall both of them die, both the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away evil from Israel.
translations.asv: If a man be found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both of them die, the man that lay with the woman, and the woman: so shalt thou put away the evil from Israel.
